heroSubtitle: Hand-stretched dough, slow-risen overnight and baked in a wood-fired oven. Order online in minutes and watch it go from oven to your door.
heroImageAlt: A wood-fired pizza straight from the oven
featuredSub: Our most-loved dishes, ready in minutes and customizable to taste.

orderingMadeEasySub: A restaurant-grade experience without the fuss of a phone call.
grabADeal: Grab a deal while it’s hot
grabADealText: Enter a code at checkout and the discount is applied instantly. No sign-up tricks, just savings.
hungryYetText: Hot pizza doesn’t wait. Order now and we’ll have it out of the oven before you finish reading this.
valueWoodFiredText: Every pizza is stone-baked in our wood-fired oven, so it arrives blistered, smoky and exactly as it should be.
valueTrackedText: Follow your order from the oven to your address — no refresh guessing, just live status updates.
valueDeliveryText: Hot, fresh and on time. Estimate {{min}}–{{max}} minutes for delivery, or grab takeout at our counter.
stepPickText: Browse the menu and customize your pizza with toppings, crust and size.
stepCheckoutText: Delivery or pickup, saved addresses and payment details make repeat orders a tap away.
stepCookText: Your order hits the wood-fired oven the moment the kitchen receives it.
stepTrackText: Follow each step in real time, from prep to the courier on your street.
aboutStory1: {{name}} began with a simple idea: great pizza doesn’t need shortcuts. Dough that rises overnight, a real wood-fired oven, and toppings chosen for flavor rather than cost.
aboutStory2: Today we bring the same care to every order — from the first stretch of the dough to the courier tapping their pedal down your street. What we’ve never automated is the craft.
valueHonestText: Flour, slow-risen dough, fresh mozzarella and sauces made in-house. If it doesn’t belong on a pizza, it’s not in our kitchen.
valueCraftText: Every pizza bakes in a wood-fired oven at a blistering heat — the crust comes out blistered, charred and just right.
valueTableText: Delivery is tracked, pickup is ready when you are, and every order is built exactly the way you asked.
comeByOrWeCome: Come by, or let us come to you
dealsThatWorkSub: Real promo codes, entered at checkout. No email walls, no fine print — just the savings that are live in the store today.
offerPizza10Text: Save a full 10% on your entire order — every pizza, side and dessert counts.
offerWelcome5Text: An easy welcome: {{amount}} straight off the total. Perfect for your first order.
offerFreeDeliveryText: Skip the delivery fee entirely by spending {{amount}} or more — or just apply the code.
offerGenericText: A limited-time saving, applied automatically at checkout.
offerHowStep1: Add your favorites to the cart and head to checkout.
offerHowStep2: Open the promo-code field in the order summary.
offerHowStep3: Enter the code — the discount is applied before you pay.
offerNote: Got an order over the free-delivery threshold? Delivery is free automatically — you don’t even need the code, but it never hurts to have it ready.
readyForAHotOneText: Pick your favorites, drop in a code at checkout and your order is in the oven before you know it.
talkToTheTeamSub: Questions about an order, feedback on the menu, or a big catering idea? Send a note and we’ll get back to you quickly.
